issues.explanation: The english field reads "RECEIVER OPERATING CHARACTERISTIC" (singular) but INSO 23681 clause 4 prints "Receiver Operating Characteristics" (plural), matching the plural Persian مشخصه‌های. The English heading should be corrected to the plural form to stay faithful to the printed evidence.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the english field to "Receiver Operating Characteristics" (plural with 's') to match what INSO 23681 clause 4 prints.

issues.explanation: The printed_evidence array only contains clause 3.4 which defines «نظام مدیریت» (management system), not the compound «نظام مدیریت هوش مصنوعی». The editor note references the document title («هوش مصنوعی – نظام مدیریت») and a clause-1 footnote distinguishing نظام from سامانه — both are printed text and valid evidence per project rules — but neither appears in the printed_evidence array. The entry text itself is transparent and honest about the compound having no independent definition, which is correct.
issues.suggested_fix: Add printed_evidence entries for (1) the INSO 42001 title page showing «هوش مصنوعی – نظام مدیریت» and (2) the clause 1 footnote on the نظام/سامانه distinction, since these are the actual loci of the compound term and are already cited in the editor note.
